features.name: massive blocky mountain
features.quote: Create a massive stylized blocky mountain landscape suitable for driving, approximately 1000x1000 studs at the base.

features.name: stepped terraced slopes
features.notes: Built from block and wedge parts
features.quote: The mountain should have a stepped, terraced appearance built from block and wedge parts

features.name: high central peak
features.quote: with a peak rising high in the center.

features.name: winding switchback roads
features.notes: Multiple routes spiraling from base to summit; at least 20 studs wide
features.quote: Include multiple winding roads with switchbacks that spiral up from the base to the summit, wide enough for vehicles (at least 20 studs wide).

features.name: road edge guardrails
features.quote: The roads should have guardrails on the outer edges.

features.name: roadside flat plateaus
features.quote: Add some flat areas or plateaus along the roads for interest.

excluded.name: editable attributes
excluded.why: editor configuration rather than visible scene content
